verdict.rationale: Trigger-and-action automation is a fair axis for a project-management tool, but the evidence shows no user-configurable rule builder in Basecamp. Automatic Check-ins are a fixed recurring question schedule, templates reuse project structure, and the REST API, CLI and MCP support are developer building blocks rather than an automation-rules capability.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can build trigger-and-action automation rules to eliminate repetitive manual steps
